test_title: PYST 35: SSC GD Constable - English (Held on: 24th November 2021 Shift 2)
subject: english
question:
**Select the most appropriate option to fill in the blank.**

The company is going to ______ the North Sea for oil.
solution:
The correct answer is '**explore**'.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The most appropriate word for the given blank is '**explore**'.
 
• It means 'to travel around a place, etc. in order to learn about it'. (किसी जगह के विषय में जानकारी प्राप्त करने के लिए उसका भ्रमण करना, खोजयात्रा करना)
 
 
• *Example: They went on an expedition to **explore** the River Brahmaputra.*
 
 
 
• If we explore for a substance such as oil or minerals, we study an area and do tests on the land to see whether we can find it.
 
• Thus, the correct answer is **Option 3.**

 

**Correct Sentence:__** *The company is going to **explore** the North Sea for oil.*

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

 
• Let's look at the meaning of other words:
 
 
• **Search**: to examine somebody/something carefully because you are looking for something; to look for something that is missing. (अभीष्‍ट वस्‍तु की खोज में किसी की बारीकी से जाँच करना; खोई हुई वस्‍तु को तलाशना)
 
• **Tour**: a journey that you make for pleasure during which you visit many places. (उल्‍लास-यात्रा, मौजमस्‍ती के लिए विभिन्‍न स्‍थानों की यात्रा; सैर-सपाटा, पर्यटन)
 
• **Traverse**: to cross or travel through an area of land or water. (स्थल क्षेत्र या जल क्षेत्र के आर पार जाना; घूमना; पार करना)
